Before You Join

Realm Application Terms

Welcome to Worlds Collide SMP! We're a tight-knit community and we take pride in keeping the vibe great for everyone. Please read the following before proceeding.

🔞 This realm is strictly 16 years of age and older. Applications from minors will not be accepted.

Community Rules
  • No griefing, theft, or destruction of other players' builds.
  • Treat all members with respect — zero tolerance for toxicity.
  • No cheating, hacking, or exploiting bugs for unfair advantage.
  • Keep the lore collaborative — big story changes should be discussed with the community.
  • Have fun and contribute positively to the realm.
🎙 Voice Memo Required

To verify your age, we ask all applicants to send a short voice memo in our Discord containing:

1. Your Minecraft Gamertag
2. Your Age
3. A brief description of why you want to join

By clicking "I Agree — Take Me to Discord" below, you confirm that you are 16 or older and agree to abide by our community rules.

Welcome, Traveller

A World Built to Last

Worlds Collide SMP isn't just another survival server — it's a living, breathing world shaped entirely by its players. No seasonal resets, no losing your hard work, no starting over. Every build, every farm, every story you write here is permanent.


What started as a small group of friends has grown into a proper realm with its own cities, lore, and legends. From the winding streets of Netherborough to mountain-top pagodas, every corner of the map carries someone's fingerprints.


Come for the vanilla survival. Stay for the lore, the friendships, and a community that genuinely looks out for each other.


The Admin Team

What We Offer

Everything You Need.
Nothing You Don't.

🌍
No World Resets — Ever

Your progress is permanent. Build your empire, write your legacy. This world doesn't reset when a new season comes around.

🤝
Friendly Community

Zero toxicity. We're a warm, welcoming group that actually helps each other out. New players are celebrated, not griefed.

📜
Rich Lore & Worldbuilding

The realm has its own lore — and you're free to add to it. Kingdoms, factions, legends. Write yourself into history.

🎮
Pure Vanilla Experience

No mods, no pay-to-win addons. Just Minecraft as it was meant to be played — clean, fair, and endlessly fun.

🏆
Community Minigames

Take a breather with Spleef, PvP arenas, and more community events. New games added as we grow.
